How we look after a garden

Garden care is all we do. Start with a visit or a Garden Intervention, then keep it right with regular care.

Garden care & maintenance

Regular visits, monthly, fortnightly or weekly, to keep a garden right all year.

  • Monthly
  • Fortnightly
  • Weekly
  • Full day 2 gardeners
  • 4 hours 2 gardeners
  • 3 hours 2 gardeners
  • 2 hours 2 gardeners
  • 1.5 hours 2 gardeners
What a visit includes
The Garden Intervention New life for planting that has lost its spark, with expert plant design. Garden health A three-visits-a-year programme: lawn, soil, feeding, and pest and disease care. Pots & planters Designed seasonal container displays for front doors, patios and businesses.

Also on the list

  • Bulb planting
  • Wellness planting
  • Hedging of all types
All services

Three steps to a garden you don't have to worry about

  1. 1

    We visit and listen

    Darragh walks the garden with you, talks about how you use it, and looks at what it needs now and through the year.

  2. 2

    We plan your schedule

    Monthly, fortnightly or weekly visits, from 1.5 hours to a full day, always with a team of two gardeners.

  3. 3

    We keep it right, all year

    We bring all the tools, work efficiently and take the green waste away. You get to simply enjoy the garden.

We don't lay paving, paths or patios. We look after gardens, and that's all we do, so yours gets our full attention every single visit.
